text: HELOTS, in Grecian antiquity, the inhabitants of Helon, a town of Lacom, conquer by the Spartan; who made them all prisoners of var, and reduced them into the condition of flares.

parsed.faithful: HELOTS, in Grecian antiquity, the inhabitants of Helos, a town of Laconia, conquered by the Spartans; who made them all prisoners of war, and reduced them into the condition of slaves.
